title: Image Embedding Standard
idiom: bold linocut, an arch held up by a framed picture
hero_prompt: Bold black-and-cream linocut print, thick carved shapes with white gouge marks, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible carved ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a tall stone archway in a plain wall, and its keystone at the top is a small framed picture of a seashell, the whole arch visibly resting on it; solid black stones, generous empty cream space, a quiet path running through the arch.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a cream ground, no shading or gradients: a stone arch whose keystone is a small square picture frame. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
